## Extensions and station levels

A bare station is level 1. Keep each extension within the displayed **4.5 m** reach; each nearby extension adds one level. Each extension requires the one before it. The source allows a 0.5 m tolerance when checking reach. Since v0.33.0 the forge goes to level 5. The **Ember Crucible** (gear tier IV, ember steel) can only be built once the Ancient Guardian has fallen and a ward stone of the Ashen Wilds burns again; the **Rune Anvil** (tier V, ashsteel) once the Dominion’s rite has been learned at the Last Forge in the Black City (a plate of ashsteel laid on its anvil). See [the rune forge](/equipment/rune-forge/).

Iron, ember-steel and ashsteel equipment can be upgraded here to +1 / +2 / +3 at station level 1 / 2 / 3. [Equipment calculator](/equipment/calculator/).
